name: citely-audit
description: Agent Skill Marketplace that audits an arbitrary website for off-site AI discoverability and on-site engagement, emitting a single evidence-backed JSON report.

skills.name: audit-orchestrator
skills.description: Sequences the audit: single safe crawl + render, runs the four analysis skills, merges/ranks findings, computes the discoverability score, validates and emits the final report.

skills.name: crawl-render-extraction-audit
skills.description: Mechanic 1 — Access, Render/Readability (raw-vs-rendered diff or browserless heuristic), and Fact Extraction over the shared crawl artifact.

skills.name: quotability-density-audit
skills.description: Mechanics 2 + 3 — RAG quotability and information-density / summarizer-survival analysis over rendered HTML.

skills.name: entity-corroboration-audit
skills.description: Mechanic 4 — structured-data (JSON-LD/OG/microdata) entity-graph extraction and optional soft-fail Wikidata corroboration.

skills.name: engagement-orientation-audit
skills.description: Mechanic 5 — deterministic first-viewport orientation and visitor-retention heuristics over the rendered DOM.

_note: marketplace.json and the `entrypoint` flag are this project's bespoke platform convention. They are NOT part of the base agentskills.io spec, which defines only the per-skill folder + SKILL.md format.
